# install: investigate possibilities of osxc

Study [osxc](https://osxc.github.io), an Ansible-based macOS configuration framework. **Motivation:** its declarative, role-based model:

```yaml
# my mac:
roles:
  - role: dashboard
    disabled: YES
  - role: brew_package
    package_name: node
  - role: cask_package
    package_name: Minecraft
```

— system settings, formulae and casks as roles in one playbook, which is the shape the `install`/Brewfile/`Apps` trio approximates by hand. To do: integration tests with [tart](https://github.com/cirruslabs/tart) ([[DOT-397]]).
